evidence.excerpt: Sabo has a preference for collaborations that involve real hardware and field validation rather than purely simulation-based studies. Her laboratory has limited availability in the autumn semester due to teaching load; project kick-off meetings and intensive measurement campaigns are better scheduled in spring or summer.
